title: The Tabernacle's Curtains and Planks Are Made
description: The skilled craftsmen made the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen, blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim skillfully worked into them. They also made eleven curtains of goat hair for the tent over it. Over that they placed a covering of red-dyed ram skins and another layer of durable leather. They constructed upright frames of acacia wood: twenty on the south side, twenty on the north side, and six on the west side, plus two corner frames, all with silver bases.
